title: Structural insight into the mechanisms and interacting features of endocrine disruptor Bisphenol A and its analogs with human estrogen-related receptor gamma.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟研究BPA及其类似物与ERRgamma（核受体，非典型TF）的互作机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA/配体互作建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究，但对象非TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Bisphenol A (BPA) is a very important chemical from the commercial perspective. Many useful products are made from it, so its production is increasing day by day. It is widely known that Bisphenol A (BPA) and its analogs are present in the environment and that they enter our body through various routes on a daily basis as we use things made of this chemical in our daily lives. BPA has already been reported to be an endocrine disruptor. Studies have shown that BPA binds strongly to the human estrogen-related receptor gamma (ERRgamma) and is an important target of it. This study seeks to understand how it interacts with ERRgamma. Molecular docking of BPA and its analogs with ERRgamma was performed, and estradiol was taken as a reference. Then, physico-chemical and toxicological analysis of BPA compounds was performed. Subsequently, the dynamic behavior of ERRgamma and ERRgamma-BPA compound complexes was studied by molecular dynamics simulations over 500 ns, and using this simulated data, their binding energies were again calculated using the MM-PBSA method. We observed that the binding affinity of BPA and its analogs was much higher than that of estradiol, and apart from being toxic, they can be easily absorbed in our body as their physicochemical properties are similar to those of oral medicines. Therefore, this study facilitates the understanding of the structure-activity relationship of ERRgamma and BPA compounds and provides information about the key amino acid residues of ERRgamma that interact with BPA compounds, which can be helpful to design competitive inhibitors so that we can interrupt the interaction of BPA with ERRgamma. In addition, it provides information on BPA and its analogs and will also be helpful in developing new therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 双酚A（BPA）是一种从商业角度来看非常重要的化学品。许多有用的产品由其制成，因此其产量日益增加。众所周知，双酚A（BPA）及其类似物存在于环境中，并且由于我们在日常生活中使用由这种化学物质制成的物品，它们每天通过多种途径进入我们的身体。已有报道指出BPA是一种内分泌干扰物。研究表明，BPA与人雌激素相关受体γ（ERRgamma）强烈结合，并且是其重要靶点。本研究旨在理解其与ERRgamma的相互作用方式。对BPA及其类似物与ERRgamma进行了分子对接，并以雌二醇作为参考。随后，对BPA化合物进行了物理化学和毒理学分析。接着，通过分子动力学模拟在500纳秒内研究了ERRgamma及ERRgamma-BPA复合物的动态行为，并利用这些模拟数据，再次使用MM-PBSA方法计算了它们的结合能。我们观察到，BPA及其类似物的结合亲和力远高于雌二醇，并且除了具有毒性外，由于它们的物理化学性质与口服药物相似，它们容易被人体吸收。因此，本研究有助于理解ERRgamma与BPA化合物的构效关系，并提供关于ERRgamma中与BPA化合物相互作用的关键氨基酸残基信息，这有助于设计竞争性抑制剂，从而中断BPA与ERRgamma的相互作用。此外，它还提供了关于BPA及其类似物的信息，并将有助于开发新的治疗方法。
